data.gender_notes: Blunt is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Blunt derives from Old English word 'bluntan', meaning 'to crush, to bruise'. The name has been used to describe someone who is straightforward and honest, someone who is unyielding and direct. It's a name for those who value honesty and directness above all else. The name Blunt carries the meaning “Direct, honest, unyielding” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blunt usually hope their child will grow to embody direct, honest, unyielding and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Blunt was originally a surname, but it has also been used as a given name since the 19th century. Culturally, it is a name that signifies someone who is straightforward and honest, someone who is unyielding and direct. Blunt individuals are known for their bluntness, their lack of subtlety, and their ability to speak their minds without sugarcoating things. This unapologetic and unfiltered personality can be seen as refreshing in a world where people often sugarcoat their words or put on fake smiles. A popular modern usage of the word "blunt" is in reference to marijuana, suggesting a strong and unadulterated effect.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Blunt can be seen as an invitation to live a life that is sincere and authentic. It is a reminder to speak the truth, even when it is difficult. Bluntness can be a powerful tool for healing and growth, helping us to confront and address issues that need attention. The name Blunt also speaks to the importance of being present in each moment, fully engaged and not holding back. By embracing our unfiltered selves, we allow ourselves to experience the richness and intensity of life, opening ourselves up to deeper connections and relationships. Ultimately, Blunt is a name for those who are willing to be real, to be honest with themselves and others, and to live with integrity.
